title: iberis linifolia subsp. timeroyi
intro: Iberis linifolia subsp. timeroyi, commonly known as Rock Cress or French Cress, is a perennial plant species native to the Mediterranean region, characterized by its linear leaves and white or pink flowers. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Iberis linifolia subsp. timeroyi include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
